DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 順番に経緯を伺っています。次にその後の出来事を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I am asking about what happened in order. Please tell me what happened after that next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、子どもの迎えの時間が迫っています。まだ話していない部分がありますが、今日は帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えのため相談を途中で中断したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me, it is nearly time to pick up my child. There are things I have not told you yet, but may I go home for today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to pause the consultation partway through because you need to pick up your child. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 緊急に確認する事項を先に伺います。今、相手が待ち伏せしているなどの危険はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask about anything urgent first. Is there any danger right now, such as the other person lying in wait for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今はありません。ただ、昨日届いたメッセージについてはまだ説明していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の危険と未説明の出来事を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not right now. However, I have not yet explained the message I received yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the current danger from an event you have not yet explained. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その部分が未確認であると記録します。今日の相談を取り下げるという意味ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record that this part has not been checked yet. You do not mean you are withdrawing today's consultation, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、取り下げません。時間のある日に続きを話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談の取下げではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right, I am not withdrawing it. I would like to continue telling you about it on a day when I have time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not withdrawing the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改めて担当へ連絡してください。今日の相談を特定できるよう、この案内の担当名をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please contact the staff member in charge again. Use the staff member's name on this information sheet so that we can identify today's consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話では担当名を伝え、昨日のメッセージの説明が残っていると言えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再連絡で伝える情報を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I phone, should I give the staff member's name and say that I still need to explain yesterday's message?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check what information to give when you contact them again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。連絡時に続きの相談方法を確認します。状況が変わって危険があれば、予約を待たず知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you contact us, we will confirm how to continue the consultation. If the situation changes and there is danger, please tell us without waiting for an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日はここまでですが相談は続けます。担当名を控えて改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談継続と危険時の対応をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will stop here for today, but continue the consultation. I will note the staff member's name and contact them again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize that you will continue the consultation and what to do if there is danger. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未確認部分を記録しました。お帰りの際も安全に気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have recorded the parts we have not checked yet. Please also take care of your safety on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差出人欄が空いていますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自宅の住所を相手に知られたくないので、勤め先の住所を書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅住所を知らせたくない希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not want the recipient to know my home address. May I write my workplace address instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not want to disclose your home address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その住所で返送や連絡を受けられるかが問題になります。勤務先の了承はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The issue is whether you can receive returned parcels or communications at that address. Do you have your workplace's permission?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。自分がそこで働いていれば使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先の了承がないと正直に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought I could use it because I work there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Honestly say that you do not have your workplace's permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで勤務先の使用を許可することはできません。発送前に利用できる連絡先を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot authorize the use of your workplace address. You need to confirm an address where you can be contacted before shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はまだ出さずに、会社へ相談します。荷物を預かってもらう必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を預けず発送を保留すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not send it today and will discuss it with my company. You do not need to keep the parcel for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to postpone shipping without leaving the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では送り状も未受付のままお返しします。住所を確かめてから記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will return the shipping label without accepting the shipment. Please confirm the address before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。前に書きかけた住所を消すより、新しい送り状に替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書きかけの送り状の交換を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Rather than erasing the address I started writing earlier, I would like a new shipping label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to replace the partly completed shipping label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しいものをお渡しします。受取人欄もあわせて確認してからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will give you a new one. Please also check the recipient section before bringing it back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。使える差出人住所を確認し、新しい送り状で持ち込み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所確認後に持ち込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will confirm a sender address I can use and bring the parcel back with the new shipping label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will bring it back after confirming the address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物と未受付の送り状をお返しします。今回は差出しをしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your parcel and the shipping label for the unaccepted shipment. Nothing has been sent this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの硬貨はすべてご入金ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to deposit all these coins?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待ってください。祖父にもらった硬貨が一枚混じっていて、それだけは残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 計数前に残したい硬貨があると止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait. One coin my grandfather gave me is mixed in, and I would like to keep that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop the process before counting because there is a coin you want to keep. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ計数機へ入れていません。こちらの台でご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not put them in the counting machine yet. Please check them yourself on this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋の底にある大きい硬貨です。これを取り出して、残りだけ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 該当する一枚を見つけて入金範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. It is the large coin at the bottom of the bag. I would like to take it out and deposit only the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the particular coin and indicate which coins you want to deposit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。取り出した硬貨と入金する袋を離して置きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Let us place the coin you removed separately from the bag to be deposited.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一枚は自分の財布へ戻します。残りの合計は分からないので、窓口で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 硬貨を財布へ分け残額の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put this coin back in my wallet. I do not know the total of the rest, so I would like to have it checked at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the coin into your wallet and ask to check the amount remaining. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取扱条件を確認した後に計数します。記念の硬貨は財布に入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will count them after confirming the handling conditions. Have you put the keepsake coin in your wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、もう別にしました。計数後に出る金額を見てから、入金の確認をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分離済みと金額確認の順序を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I have already separated it. I will confirm the deposit after seeing the amount shown after counting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the coin has been separated and explain the order for checking the amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では残りを確認します。金額をご提示してから手続きを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will check the rest. We will show you the amount before proceeding with the transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。取っておく一枚は含めず、提示された金額を確認して入金します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取置き硬貨を除いた入金に同意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will confirm the amount shown and deposit it without including the coin I am keeping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to deposit the coins excluding the one you are keeping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの袋だけお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take only this bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお菓子を二箱お求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like two boxes of these sweets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ動物のおまけを姉妹へ渡したいので、同じ色の箱を選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱の色で同じおまけを二個選んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to give two sisters the same animal bonus toy, so I chose boxes of the same color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose two boxes by color to get two identical bonus toys. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の色でおまけは選べません。この商品は、外から中の種類が分からない設定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You cannot choose the toy by the box color. With this product, you cannot tell which type is inside from the outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では同じ色を二箱買っても、違う動物になるかもしれませんね。売場で開けて確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ランダム封入を理解し開封して確かめられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then even if I buy two boxes of the same color, they might contain different animals. May I open them here in the shop to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the contents are random and ask whether you may open the boxes to check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入前には開けないでください。種類を確認して渡したいなら、中身の表示がある別の商品を探せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not open them before purchase. If you want to check the type before giving them as gifts, we can look for a different product whose contents are labeled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。おまけは不明でも、お菓子の材料は外の表示で確認できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明なおまけと確認できる原材料表示を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Even if we do not know the bonus toy, we can check the ingredients of the sweets on the outside label, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the unknown bonus toy from the ingredients label you can check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、食品の原材料表示と、おまけの種類の案内は別です。どちらを優先したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The food ingredients label and the information about the bonus toy are separate. Which would you like to prioritize?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は二人に同じ物を渡すことを優先します。お菓子はやめ、種類が分かる小物を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ贈り物を優先して種類が分かる別商品を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I want to prioritize giving both of them the same thing. I will pass on the sweets and would like to look at small items whose types I can identify.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize identical gifts and ask for another product whose type is identifiable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 文具売場に同じ動物の鉛筆があります。二本そろうか担当者へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are pencils with the same animal design in the stationery section. Let us ask the staff member whether two are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。箱は開けずにお渡しします。同じ鉛筆が二本あれば、それを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封品を係員へ渡し同一小物二本の在庫確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will hand you the boxes unopened. If there are two identical pencils, I will choose those.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand the unopened items to the staff member and ask them to check stock for two identical small items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お菓子は会計せず、文具の在庫を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will not charge you for the sweets and will check the stationery stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その花は作業中の物です。お手を触れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Those flowers are part of the work in progress. Please do not touch them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、袋の横に置いてあったので、捨てる花ならもらえるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 捨てる花と思った理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. They were next to a bag, so I thought I might be allowed to have them if they were going to be thrown away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you thought the flowers were being discarded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別の花壇へ移す物もあります。どれを持ち帰りたいと思われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some of them will be moved to another flower bed. Which one were you hoping to take home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい苗です。まだ持っていません。置いてあるだけで不要と決めてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手を触れていない苗を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This small seedling. I have not picked it up yet. I assumed it was unwanted simply because it was sitting there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the seedling you have not touched. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは植え替え用です。持ち帰りはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is for transplanting. You cannot take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。花を育てたいのですが、苗を分ける催しなどの案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持帰りを諦め配布案内を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would like to grow flowers. Is there information about events where seedlings are given out or shared?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give up taking it home and ask about seedling distribution information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の催しは管理事務所の掲示で確認できます。今日ここでお渡しする苗はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check current events on the notice board at the management office. There are no seedlings being given out here today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 掲示を見ます。作業の方に何度も尋ねるより、事務所で日程を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 催しの日程を事務所で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at the notice board. Instead of repeatedly asking the people working here, I will check the dates at the office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check event dates at the office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。苗を踏まないよう、通路側からお通りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Walk along the path side so that you do not step on the seedlings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。花はそのままにし、通路から管理事務所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 苗を残し安全な通路へ移ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will leave the flowers as they are and take the path to the management office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave the seedlings and move to the safe path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。作業区画の外をお通りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please stay outside the work area as you pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの券についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about this ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日使う券です。準備しておこうと思い、今この機械に通そうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日用の券を事前準備したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a ticket for tomorrow. I wanted to prepare in advance, so I was about to put it through this machine now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to prepare a ticket for tomorrow in advance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの操作をしようとしていますか。日付の印字を伴う操作は先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: What operation are you trying to perform? Please check first before doing anything that prints a date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使用する日付を付ける機械だと思いました。明日の日付を選べるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機械で翌日の日付を選べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought this machine put the date of use on the ticket. Can I select tomorrow's date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can choose the following day's date on the machine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の機械は本日の使用を記録する物です。明日の準備のためには通さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The machine in this learning material records use on today's date. Please do not put the ticket through it to prepare for tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ入れていません。券はこのまま持ち帰り、明日の乗車時に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未操作で券を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not inserted it yet. I will take the ticket home as it is and use it when I board tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not operated the machine and will take the ticket home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。券に書かれた利用条件も読んでおきましょう。使用できる期間はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let us also read the usage conditions printed on the ticket. Here is the period when it can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日はその期間に入っています。友人の券も同じ期間か、今見比べてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の券の期間も照合したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tomorrow falls within that period. May I compare my friend's ticket now too, to check whether it covers the same period?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the validity period on your companion's ticket too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示の確認はできます。二枚とも未使用のまま、期間を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may check the printed information. Please keep both tickets unused while checking the period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は印字せず、二人分の利用期間だけ確認して帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の表示確認と明日の使用を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not have anything printed today; I will just check the validity periods for both of us and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish checking the printed information today from using the tickets tomorrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 明日のご利用時に、分からない点があれば改札係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: If you have any questions when using them tomorrow, please ask the ticket gate staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 番号札をお持ちの方ですね。ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a numbered ticket, correct? Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 札は母の分です。母は椅子に座っています。先に私が全部説明してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号札の本人が母だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The ticket is for my mother. She is sitting over there. May I explain everything first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the numbered ticket belongs to your mother. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の希望も確認します。お母様は説明を手伝ってほしいとおっしゃっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will also confirm her own wishes. Has your mother said that she would like help explaining things?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ただ、私が手続きを代わりにするとは頼まれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明支援と手続代行を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. However, she has not asked me to handle the procedure on her behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish help with explanations from handling the procedure on someone else's behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では最初にお二人の役割を確認しましょう。お母様が来られる席をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us confirm your respective roles first. We will prepare a seat your mother can come to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。私は聞き取れない言葉を説明する役で、判断や署名は母に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人判断と自分の通訳役を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: That would help. My role is to explain words she cannot understand, so please check decisions and signatures with my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that your mother makes the decisions and your role is to interpret. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。途中で意見が違った場合は、ご本人へ直接伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. If your opinions differ during the discussion, we will ask her directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。私の返事をそのまま母の同意として進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の返答を本人同意にしないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Please do not proceed by treating my answers automatically as my mother's consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them not to treat the accompanying person's answers as the applicant's own consent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を確認してから伺います。お母様にこちらへお越しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will confirm that before asking our questions. Could you ask your mother to come over here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、呼んできます。本人と話していただき、必要な時だけ私が言葉を補います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人を呼び必要時だけ補助すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will get her. Please speak with her directly, and I will help with the wording only when needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will bring the person over and assist only when needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの席でお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will be waiting at these seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察で相談したいことは、問診のこちらの欄ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the section of the medical questionnaire for what you want to discuss during your consultation, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事へ戻れるか聞きたいです。会社が軽作業と呼んでいるので、そう書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 軽作業という記載で仕事復帰を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to ask whether I can return to work. My company calls it light work, so that is what I wrote.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote 'light work' and want to discuss returning to work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名前だけでは、どのように体を使うか分からない場合があります。実際には何をするお仕事ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The label alone may not tell us how you use your body. What do you actually do at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱を運びます。一箱は五キロほどで、階段を上り下りして二時間続ける日もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱の重さと階段と継続時間を具体的に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I carry boxes. Each box weighs about five kilograms, and on some days I keep going up and down stairs for two hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the box weight, stairs, and duration specifically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その内容も担当者へ伝えます。作業を替えてもらえるか、勤務先には確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff member that too. Have you checked with your workplace whether you could be assigned different tasks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。軽作業という名前なら大丈夫と決めていました。別の作業があるか、会社にも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代替作業は未確認だと述べ勤務先にも確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I assumed it would be fine because it was called light work. I will also ask my company whether there are other tasks available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that alternative tasks have not been confirmed and that you will check with your workplace too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診療担当者には実際の動きと、ご相談の内容を説明してください。受付では復帰の可否を判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain your actual movements and what you want to discuss to the clinical staff. Reception does not decide whether you can return to work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱の重さ、階段、続ける時間をメモに足します。診察で必要な条件を尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付で判断せず実作業のメモを追加し医療者へ条件を尋ねたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will add the box weight, the stairs, and how long I work continuously to my notes. I would like to ask about the necessary conditions during my consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not seek a decision at reception, will add notes about the actual tasks, and want to ask medical staff about the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社から作業内容の資料があれば、その内容も見せてください。いま持っている案内には何が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your company has documents describing the tasks, please show those too. What does the information you have with you now say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 軽作業という呼び名と勤務時間だけです。これだけで全部分かると思わず、実際の作業を説明して診察を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参資料の不足を示し呼び名だけでなく実作業を診察で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only the description 'light work' and my working hours. I will not assume that tells the whole story; I will explain the actual tasks during my consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the limits of the documents you brought and describe the actual work during the consultation, rather than relying only on the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その希望と追加した内容を担当者へ引き継ぎます。復帰については診察でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your request and the additional details on to the staff member. Please discuss returning to work during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このメッセージを受け取った時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know what time you received this message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真には八時とありますが、その端末は海外の家族が設定した時刻のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外設定の端末時刻だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The photo says eight o'clock, but that device still uses the time setting my family overseas configured.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the device time is set for overseas. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日本で見た時刻と画面の表示が違う可能性があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the time you saw it in Japan may differ from the time displayed on the screen, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。差を引いて書こうとしましたが、夏時間かどうかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夏時間が不明で換算できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I was going to subtract the difference when writing it down, but I do not even know whether daylight saving time applied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot convert the time because you do not know whether daylight saving time applied. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で換算せず、表示をそのまま残してください。その時、何をしていたか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not convert it yourself; leave the display unchanged. Do you remember what you were doing at the time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日本では夕食の後でした。正確な時計は見ていないので、何時とは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正確な時計と行動の記憶を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was after dinner in Japan. I did not look at an accurate clock, so I cannot give a specific time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish an exact clock time from your memory of what you were doing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示の八時と、夕食後に見たという記憶を分けて記録します。端末の設定も後で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the displayed eight o'clock separately from your memory of seeing it after dinner. Can we also check the device settings later?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できます。今ここで設定を変えると元の表示が変わるかもしれないので、先に見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設定変更前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If I change the settings here now, the original display might change, so I would like you to look at it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for it to be checked before the settings are changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では現在の表示と設定を確認する手順を相談しましょう。勝手に変更する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us discuss how to check the current display and settings. There is no need to change them on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。時刻を断定せず、写真と端末の設定を別々に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示時刻を断定せず資料を示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not state a definite time; I will show the photo and device settings separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the materials without asserting a definite displayed time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお持ちください。確認できた範囲を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep it as it is and bring it with you. We will record what we can confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受取人のお名前はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the correct recipient name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: インターネットで使う名前しか知りません。住所は教えてもらいましたが、この名前で届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手の呼び名しか知らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only know the name they use on the internet. They gave me their address, but will it be delivered under this name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you only know the name the other person goes by. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらではその呼び名で受け取れる方か判断できません。受取人へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine whether they can receive it under that name. Can you check with the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。こちらで本名を調べてもらえると思っていましたが、自分で聞く必要があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口で本名を調べられると思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought you could look up their real name here, but I need to ask them myself, don't I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding that the counter could look up their real name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個人のお名前をこちらから調べてお伝えすることはできません。宛名に使う表記を相手へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot look up and disclose a private individual's name. Please ask the recipient what name to use on the address label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物をまだ受け付けず、返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名確認まで受付を保留して返却を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Could you return the parcel without accepting it yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to postpone acceptance and have the parcel returned until the addressee's name is confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ受付前ですのでお返しします。住所と宛名が確認できてからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so I will return it. Please bring it back once you have confirmed the address and addressee's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手が本名を教えたくない場合は、無理に聞かず、別の受取方法を相手と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本名開示を強要せず受取方法を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they do not want to tell me their real name, I will not insist. I will discuss another way for them to receive it with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not force disclosure of their real name and will discuss a way to receive the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場合も、利用できる方法の条件を確認してから発送してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case too, please confirm the conditions of an available method before sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。呼び名だけで差し出さず、相手が受け取れる表記と方法を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手が受け取れる条件を確認してから送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not send it using only their nickname. I will confirm the name format and method that allow them to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send it after checking the conditions that allow the recipient to receive it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの荷物をお返しします。今回の受付は行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your parcel. We have not accepted a shipment this time.
